QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] Those Who Protect the Camp
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #bAthena Pierce#k and ask about the situation.
QuestInfo.1:
Athena Pierce explained the situation and asked that you help the people at camp as they are short a few hands.
Go to #bTess#k in #bAltaire Camp#k and she will assign you some work.
QuestInfo.2:
When the battle between the heroes and the Black Mage broke out, Athena Pierce headed for the southern plains with the refugees.
However, they were #rforced to land in this place because dragons attacked#k. But why did the dragons attack the airship?
This question weighed on your mind as you helped the people at camp as requested by Athena Pierce.
